death.attack.sweatyfeet.fungus: %1$s was consumed from within by foot fungus
death.attack.sweatyfeet.fungus.player: %1$s was consumed by foot fungus whilst fighting %2$s
sweatyfeet.config.title: Sweaty Feet Config
sweatyfeet.config.discard.title: Discard changes?
sweatyfeet.config.level1_seconds.desc: Total seconds of wearing boots to trigger Sweaty Feet level 1 (sweatify and rename).
sweatyfeet.config.level2_seconds.desc: Total seconds of wearing boots to reach level 2 (sliding).
sweatyfeet.config.level3_seconds.desc: Total seconds of wearing boots to reach level 3 (sliding + slow).
sweatyfeet.config.enable_fungus.desc: If off, sweaty feet stops at level 3 and never becomes fungus.
sweatyfeet.config.fungus_delay_seconds.d: Seconds of continued boot wearing after level 3 to start the fungus (infinite).
Whether the fungus periodically deals damage (magic damage, ignores armor, can kill).
sweatyfeet.config.fungus_damage_interval: Seconds between each 1-damage tick of the fungus.
sweatyfeet.config.fungus_infection_enabl: Whether standing near an infected player spreads the fungus.
sweatyfeet.config.fungus_infection_range: Radius in blocks for fungus spreading.
sweatyfeet.config.smell_enabled.desc: Barefoot players with sweaty feet give nearby players nausea (not themselves).
sweatyfeet.config.smell_range.desc: Radius for the foot stink; stronger nausea at higher sweaty feet levels.
sweatyfeet.config.effect_seconds.desc: Duration of one sweaty feet effect instance, refreshed while wearing.
sweatyfeet.config.throw_debuff_seconds.d: Duration of level-1 sweaty feet when hit by a thrown sweat bottle.
sweatyfeet.config.drink_poison_seconds.d: Poison duration from drinking a level-3 sweat bottle.
Nausea duration from drinking a level-2 sweat bottle.
sweatyfeet.config.drink_buff_seconds.des: Buff duration of the speed/strength drinks.
sweatyfeet.config.degrade_seconds.desc: Countdown per level after removing boots: 3->2->1->gone.
sweatyfeet.config.wash_seconds.desc: Consecutive seconds barefoot in water or on a basin to clear sweaty feet (skips degrade; fungus not washable).
sweatyfeet.config.wash_boots_enabled.des: Whether sweaty boots thrown into water can be washed back to normal.
sweatyfeet.config.wash_boots_seconds.des: Seconds in water for sweaty boots to wash clean.
sweatyfeet.config.slide_enabled.desc: From level 2, movement friction becomes ice-like (sliding).
sweatyfeet.config.sweat_particles.desc: Whether the sweaty feet effect spawns sweat particles.
sweatyfeet.config.sweat_particle_scale.d: Multiplier for sweat particle count; more at higher levels.
sweatyfeet.config.soak_undress_enabled.d: Lower body skin replaced with skin tone while sitting on the soak set/stool (client-side visual).
sweatyfeet.config.debug_undress.desc: Log [SF] undress lines whenever the resolve result changes.
sweatyfeet.picker.title: Eyedropper: click skin to pick tint
sweatyfeet.picker.hint: Click any pixel of the unfolded skin; Esc to cancel
sweatyfeet.picker.noskin: Skin not loaded yet, try again shortly
sweatyfeet.picker.noskin2: Read the in-game skin texture; if it still fails, check skin server network
sweatyfeet.config.soak_undress_tint.desc: e.g. #C68863; empty = auto-sample from the player's skin.
sweatyfeet.config.sneeze_particles.desc: Whether the fungus infection spawns sneeze particles.
sweatyfeet.config.debug_show_ticks.desc: Show wear ticks and sweaty feet level above the hotbar to verify timing.
sweatyfeet.config.debug_force_fungus.des: Force fungus while wearing boots, skipping the level-3 wait.
sweatyfeet.config.debug_state_log.desc: Log one state line per second (wear/degrade/wash/basin/fungus/held); grep [SF] in latest.log.
sweatyfeet.config.debug_flow_log.desc: Log basin guard chain, pour success/failure, spread, smell and advancement grants.
sweatyfeet.config.debug_force_sweat.desc: Sweatify instantly while wearing boots, skipping the 30 s timer.
sweatyfeet.config.debug_force_level3.des: Treat sweaty boots as level 3 immediately, for testing fermented boots without waiting.

sweatyfeet.msg.basin_dirty: The water is dirty, scoop it out!

sweatyfeet.msg.soak_done: Done soaking! The water is dirty now...
item.sweatyfeet.sweat_bottle.tooltip1: A bottle filled with a player's sweat
item.sweatyfeet.floral_water.tooltip1: Herbal fragrance - pour it into the foot-washing water to cure fungus
item.sweatyfeet.floral_water.tooltip2: In real life, floral water cannot remove foot fungus! If infected, see a doctor and apply prescribed antifungal medication
item.sweatyfeet.wash_water_bucket.toolti: Dirty water from freshly washed feet
item.sweatyfeet.fermented_boots.tooltip1: Used to make rich sweat drinks - the longer you wear them, the better they get
item.sweatyfeet.diluted_floral_water.too: Foot-washing water with floral water added
effect.sweatyfeet.sweaty_feet.descriptio: Triggered by cumulative boot wear time; higher levels are worse - level 2+ makes you slide (less friction), level 3 nauseates you while holding sweaty boots, pollutes nearby players when dropped, and raises green stink particles around your feet
effect.sweatyfeet.foot_fungus.descriptio: Triggered by wearing boots past level-3 sweaty feet; lasts forever - slows you down, makes you sneeze periodically, deals periodic damage that ignores armor, and while barefoot sheds green stink particles that nauseate nearby players and can infect them
item.sweatyfeet.sweaty_hint: Hold an empty glass bottle in offhand, sneak + right-click to pour a sweat bottle

sweatyfeet.patchouli.title: Sweaty Feet Guide
sweatyfeet.patchouli.landing: Welcome to "Sweaty Feet"!$(br2)This handbook teaches you: what to do when you get "sweaty feet" from never taking off your boots, how to wash your feet, how to brew Sweat Drinks, and how to survive a foot fungus infection.$(br2)$(bold)A friendly reminder:$(clear)in real life, wash your feet when they sweat, and see a doctor if you get a fungal infection.
